permissions.//: additionalDirectories: build output lives on nas/build (/var/lib/build, see roles/nas.bash) and is reached through symlinks such as ~/teahouse/.claude/worktrees; Claude Code checks the resolved path, so without this every Edit/Write in an agent workspace asks for approval.

env.//: Headless: no ssh-agent here. Empty means 'no agent'; env.d honors an explicit-empty and leaves it, so ssh uses ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 directly. See ssh-agent-forwarding-architecture memory.
